$comment: Arbor standard provider configuration. Copy to arbor.config.json and edit. Three secret modes: inline (key value right here — keep the file out of VCS; it is materialized into a process-local SecretStore, never logged), env (ref names the environment variable), file (ref is a key-file path, relative to root). Lookup order: $ARBOR_CONFIG, ./arbor.config.json, ~/.config/arbor/arbor.config.json.
